theorem_title: Side-connected integer squares and their unit boundary
natural_language_statement: Squares are indexed by integer pairs. The four side neighbors differ by one in exactly one coordinate. A finite set is connected when it is nonempty and any two members can be joined by a finite sequence of side-neighbor steps within the set. Each exposed side is a direction from an occupied square to an unoccupied neighbor. The perimeter counts all such sides, including hole boundaries. The wall set records the occupied square and side direction.
source: Mathe, The Angel of power 2 wins (2007), https://doi.org/10.1017/S0963548306008303, author manuscript p. 6, Definition 4.1 and Claim 4.2.
